[[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] '''Gun Tugs''' were small, two-seat spacecraft often employed by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and space scavengers.

==Characteristics==
Gun Tugs were designed for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] market and other less "civilized" areas as a cheap and easy transport craft. The two [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] were the ship's primary armament, which limited the offensive capabilities. For more traditional combat, the Gun Tug also sported a pair of fire-linked blaster cannons. The Gun Tug was ideal to move large cargos around and defend them from possible raids.

==History==
The Gun [[Spacetug/Legends|Tugs]] were designed in the latter days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] and were sold to trading companies in less developed sectors. However, when trade exploration into these areas died down, SoroSuub stopped selling and producing these ships.<ref name="SOTG" />

By this time, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] had discovered the use of the Gun Tug. Other ships disabled larger ships and Gun Tugs were used to haul them away. Although Gun Tugs were never really common among pirate [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], those few outlaw organizations who possed them maintained them carefully and put them to good use.<ref name="SOTG" />

Gun Tugs were used by the pirate [[Arns Grimraker]],<ref name="HS">[[Star Wars (1977) 78|''Star Wars'' (1977) 78]]</ref> the [[Nebula Raiders/Legends|Nebula Raiders]]<ref name="SOTG" /> and the [[Sons and Daughters of Freedom]]<ref name="JT">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref>.
